text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's time for the spring Tenno Sho at
last.
The
weather is sunny and clear over the
Yodo turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Grandfather, Grandmother. The day
has finally
come.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please watch me as I run, and watch the
moment I
seize victory!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
All right... I'm ready now.
I think I can do
it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I will! Keep your eyes on me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it our all as members of the
Mejiro
family.
